title: Chapter 695
paragraphs: Chapter 695
Episode 177. Yona, Yona, Yona......(4)
After the curtain of chaos closed again, the summoned monsters roared. The energy of those creatures distorted the curtain and blurred the view, and the Yonas started to move again.
'Joshua used the monsters to maximize the abilities of my sister and the fakes... He's low-minded in every aspect.'
Joshua had not reached the level of Jin, so he must have thought that such shallow tactics would work against the three of them.

Such pranks can't disturb the senses of superhumans. Of course, considering the characteristics of Yona and the fakes, even the smallest variable can be a threat, but even that was laughable against our group.
"It's something. You must have had a hard time dealing with such a thing as the 2nd generation, Jin."
"It was quite embarrassing in many ways."
Hedo was the first to step forward and spread the realm of swordsmanship. The sword energy, spreading like a wave, covered the monsters and created a dazzling light.

While bones and flesh were pouring like rain in a disorderly manner, three of the Yonas simultaneously targeted Hedo. Unlike Jin, he could not immediately distinguish the real one, so he could only fend off the attacks.
"Please keep defending against my sister and the fakes. I'll take care of them one by one."
"Got it."
The debris of the monsters swept by the swordsmanship gathered again to form another monster.
It looked like their regeneration was faster than Hedo's slaughter.
Hedo seemed to dislike this fact (and also did not like the temporary sword he brought), so he frowned and pulled up his strength even more.
However, it was awkward to swing that power recklessly. He had to stop the proliferation of the monsters, but if he doubled his power than now, Yonas could be swept away.
'Do I have to solve it in close combat? That would expand the scope that Jin has to handle, which would be annoying.'
The moment Hedo was about to ponder, something popped out of Owl's sleeve.
It was thousands of threads, each thinner than a hair.
Each one, infused with Owl's energy, grabbed the monsters at random.
As soon as Owl saw the monster disintegrating because it couldn't hold out, he demonstrated delicate control by adjusting his power and tying them up.
"Oh, it will be much easier, King of the Nameless. I've been amazed by your ability."
"Originally, I saved it to control the fakes, but there is no need for it since Jin can distinguish."
While the superhumans were exchanging compliments, Jin cut down one more fake.
'Now only my sister and five fakes are left.'
From then on, the Yonas did not easily target Jin.
It was not a calculated situation, it was instinct. Based on Jin's fight, Yonas were currently without rationality.
They were simply carrying out Joshua's orders blindly. If the fakes had the level of judgment that Yona had before going berserk in chaos, Jin would have had a bit of trouble.
Whoosh...!
Jin's blurry demon sword was illuminating the surroundings like a torch. The Yonas were struggling to avoid watching that sword.
This was because they felt a burning pain somewhere inside their bodies the moment their gaze stayed on the fire of the sword.
Jin knew very well that such power was contained in his sword, which he had not yet named.
So now, Jin began to look for the Yonas first. Every time Bradamante pierced the void, the figures of the Yonas briefly revealed themselves and then disappeared like smoke.
It would take quite a lot of time in this way. In fact, Jin couldn't kill the fakes for a while and just explored the void.
But Jin brought the strong ones from each power to prevent such a situation.
Crack-!
Jin swung his sword like a bell and completely tore one side of the void.
"Ah!"
"Wow, surprising..."
At the same time, Ranke and Bianca showed surprised faces, their eyes wide open.
They were just about to pierce the void when they arrived nearby.
"You're here."
"How... did you... know we..."
"How did I know? Ah, it's frustrating. Bianca, can't you speak a bit faster? Seriously?"
"How did you know... you read our energy?"
"Read our... energy?"
Ranke and Bianca looked at each other with bewildered expressions. They couldn't sense the energy flowing inside due to the curtain of chaos.
"Anyway, come in quickly and press my sister and the fakes. I mean, defend and push them."
"How do we push them by just defending, not attacking?"
"I'm pressuring them, so you can do it. And let me say it again, it won't be fun if my real sister gets hurt by any chance. Well, then, let's cheer up."
Ranke muttered a curse, and Bianca nodded and entered the curtain.
With the addition of the two, the Yonas seemed to focus solely on hiding, and Jin slowly became sure that they would run away.
'The entrance where the Kinzelos entered is not being restored. It's probably a phenomenon that occurred because Bale is looking for Joshua and engaged in a fight.'

It was restored right away when Bale opened it. It was possible then because Joshua was continuously sending his energy here, but not now. He couldn't care less about this place as he was dealing with enraged Bale.
Jin pretended not to guard the empty entrance he created. He deliberately distanced himself from the entrance and waited for the Yonas to appear.
The Yonas, left only with their instincts, ran into the trap all too easily. One fake, the moment Jin turned his back, deactivated its camouflage and charged toward the entrance.
Of course, the fake could not escape outside.
Ssssssssh!
This was because the magic Jin had planted at the entrance in advance formed an ice wall.
The fake tried to break the barrier with its sword at that moment, but in the meantime, Jin caught it from behind.
"Where do you think you're going?"
Bradamante pierced through the fake's back. The fake shivered and oxidized, leaving a black lump.
"Another fake wanting to leave?"
Jin said with a smile. Now there were only four fakes left, and as the number decreased, the choices for the Yonas were reduced.
In the vicinity of the center of the void, Hedo and Owl were still suppressing the determined demons, and Ranke and Bianca charged and hit the wall every time Jin's fire found Yona.
"We can't... until... the real one... comes out."
"Ah, that idiot is helping us till the end."
Jin, looking around slowly. He thought that at this rate, he could deal with the remaining fakes and take Yona back within thirty minutes.
However, the good feeling was brief.
Suddenly, the void of chaos began to vibrate unstably.
"Eh? Hey! The void looks like it's going to explode?"
Ranke shouted. Everyone else also realized that the void was showing signs of an explosion.
The reason for the problem in the void was obvious. Joshua was spreading ash in his last struggle.
'Joshua, this bastard is doing this until the end. It looks like he chose to self-destruct after getting beaten up by Bale.'
In that case, he had to quickly change the strategy and respond.
"Everyone, spread out and stop the explosion as much as possible!"
The scale of the void explosion could not be predicted accurately. The entire forest could disappear, and perhaps even the distant houses could be damaged.
As Jin shouted, Hedo and Owl, Bianca and Ranke took their places spreading in all directions.
The Yonas also seemed startled by the sudden collapse of the void. They screamed like beasts trapped in a wildfire, frantically running around the void.
And Jin heightened all the senses he had.
'No matter how powerful the explosion is, if those four block it with full force, it won't affect the houses.'
Therefore, he had to find his sister and protect her. She currently didn't have the strength to protect herself from such a massive explosion.
Even if it exists, it's not Yona but the power of chaos.
The power of chaos, the moment Yona's flesh collapses, naturally corrodes her to restore her. That is, it meant that the body transformation that Jin is most wary of happens.
Rrrrrr...!
The chaos that made up the void was converging into one point. In about 5 seconds, all the power will gather and explode.
Jin had to find the real one among the fakes inside and hold her.
But there was a reason why the remaining strong ones, especially Owl who cherishes Yona as much as Jin does, obediently followed his order to handle the explosion instead of finding her.
It was because they were confident. They said that Jin is more than capable of it.
Jin threw himself forward in a rush. Just like grabbing a child about to fall into the water.
"Sister!"
Yona was still holding a sword, but Jin disregarded it and hugged her tightly. He nearly got stabbed in the abdomen by Yona's sword, but fortunately, he was able to deflect it.
Then, as the void exploded, Yona tightly closed her eyes, and Jin spread a protective shield while holding her.
Kwaaaaaa...! Kdududuk!
The bodies of the fakes rushing towards the siblings like a maw were being disassembled.
[Kiaaaaaaa...!]
[Gag!]
The fire in the void burnt even the black lumps left by them.
The explosion that started with a deafening noise continued for over five minutes from then.
The strong ones swung their weapons without rest and spread the shield, and Jin was finally able to protect his little sister.
"Is everyone okay?"
Hedo was the first to look around and ask.
"I'm safe. The most remarkable explosion was handled by you, and there isn't a single residual injury."
"I should have something better than you. It seems like the executives of Kinzelo are also safe. Hmm, is that friend not?"
"Huh, huh... What the hell is this hardship, I thought I was going to die!"
"Ranke... weak... enough to... block."
"Damn it! Cough, choke!"
As Ranke, who shouted angrily, fell down vomiting blood, Bianca hurriedly supported him. Jin was still holding Yona behind them.
He was full of wounds on his neck and back. Yona, still in a rampaging state, continued to scratch Jin, but he was just happy.
"Sister. Let's go now, home."
Yona responded with a scream, and the rest of the party except Jin looked up at the sky at the same time.
In the sky, a fleet of Zips that had just arrived here was floating.
